name: How can one lose so much and gain so little?
Ils ne passeront pas! Not another inch!
The UNF center yields to the conservatives of Wurie.
The UNF center yields to Sankoh’s liberals.
The CPP adopts a system inspired by the Syndicalists.
Nkrumah clamps down on opposition and declares a one-party state.
The Autocratic Royalists re-establish the Ashanti Kingdom!
Nkrumah fends off all enemies of the revolution!
No, we should keep our independence!
Allahu Akbar!
Damn Barzinji!
